steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Turn your face slightly to the right.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Like this?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, taking the shot now!

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: We are merely confirming a detail with a swift snapshot. Why the solemnity?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: True enough, but there's nothing wrong with taking a nice photo. Let's make it a memento of today.

You return the camera to the young tourist and instruct the staff to escort her away and clear the area. Then, holding the photo, you give it a gentle shake. Under the sunlight, the image gradually comes into view.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Just as I thought, this one's no different.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Indeed. Right beside my right foot is that round white shape.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It really is a little Wisp...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: How curious. By all accounts, you should have "concluded" all the characters from that story.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: To think that a little Wisp—its lingering will and power so faint that it couldn't even take shape—managed to endure the final "eruption"...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Fascinating, truly fascinating... Following you always leads to the most intriguing tales.
Yugu holds the photo, resting her chin on her hand in contemplation.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: If memory serves me well, you mentioned an encounter with a similar little Wisp at the fete—one bearing a camera and photographs akin to these?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Right. If I'm the only one who can sense it now, and only this kind of camera can capture it...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then the only missing piece to make it manifest... would be your power, wouldn't it?
Yugu nods, gently plants her long banner into the ground, and removes her veil.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Dearest audience, allow me to regale you with... a most enthralling narrative.
Her voice, now unveiled, takes on a different tone, a mesmerizing melody that weaves through the air. As if guided by unseen strings, you find yourself drawn into yet another "tale."
While the surroundings remain unchanged—even the nearby staff members haven't turned to look—you both clearly see it: a small, round white shadow lying motionless among the ruins and debris.
You crouch down and clear away the debris, then reach out with a single finger to gently poke the ethereal form.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Wake up, little one. Are you still conscious?

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Uh...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Looks like it might still be conscious...

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Who... who's... what is this...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No more sleeping, little one. Wake up and see where you are.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Where? But I was at... at home... Huh?!
If with the darkness of night, you might be able to see more clearly how the misty white shadow trembles in shock. But even without a visible expression, its surprise is palpable.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I'm afraid this place isn't your home, poor little one.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Can you remember anything? For instance... why are you here?
Your presence beside Yugu evidently instills shock in the little one, causing it to instinctively back away until it bumps into some rubble.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't be afraid. We just want to figure out what's going on together with you. We mean you no harm.
You reach out your hand, offering it to the little Wisp as one would to a skittish kitten upon first meeting. Seeing this, Yugu kneels down and follows your example, extending her hand as well.
Perhaps sensing the similar power emanating from both you and Yugu, the little Wisp finally stops flinching and begins to speak in halting words.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: jojo

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: First there was the smell of flowers, and then... then the sound of someone reading, and lots of... laughter...

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Then, then there were yellow-orange lanterns... the moon... and after that... after that...
The little Wisp grows agitated, circling in place and stirring up some dust around itself.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Most Wisps are born from intense lingering attachments. Though they lack physical form or power, they often retain quite a few fragments of their memories.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Take it easy. Give yourself a moment to remember.

As Yugu's soothing words reach the Wisp, you perceive her gradual release of power. As a spiritual remnant born from Mania and sustained by the same power, the little one eventually calms down and settles.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: After that... I walked for a long time... a very long time...

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: I saw a fete... and a... huge tree, with the same scent of flowers I smelled...

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: But then... there was a boom, a crash so loud, and shaking ground, fire...

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Everyone was crying... running...
You and Yugu remain silent, listening as the little one rambles through its memories.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: It hurt so much, like I was breaking apart into a thousand pieces. I floated around, trying to find somewhere safe. Right when I was almost gone...

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Something came down from the sky and wrapped around me. It got all dark, but the hurting wasn't as bad as before.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: And then... and then it was... just now, when you woke me up...
You glance beside the little one and spot a fragment of fabric nestled beneath the debris. Despite being worn and torn, the material and hue seem familiar—it appears to be the coat you usually wear.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Could it be from when I changed into that... whatever that mystical garment was...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: It appears that your benevolent spirit has influenced even your possessions, Chief. They too have embraced the art of offering refuge, mirroring your noble ways.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Perhaps that's not the only reason. As you mentioned, these beings are formed from lingering attachments. To survive that collapse, this one's desire must have been incredibly strong.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Do you remember what you were really attached to? You showing up here... could it be because of some unfinished business?
Your question is met with a long silence from the little Wisp. Finally, it trembles slightly before speaking in a halting voice.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Unfinished business... my unfinished business...

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: I think... there was something I really wanted to do... but...

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: What was it... Ugh!

A faint wave of Mania radiates from the little Wisp, causing the "flame" enveloping it to grow more violent. Both you and Yugu furrow your brows in concern as you sense the temperature abruptly spikes.
You stand up and exchange a meaningful glance with Yugu, who shakes her head slightly.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: It's not in a good state.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yeah, I can tell.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: It was supposed to vanish with the illusion's collapse, yet through a curious turn of fate, it endured.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: However, it was exposed to an excess of Mania in this course of events, causing disruptions in its memories.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's not just living in the illusion you created anymore. The situation has gotten a lot more complicated for it. I can see it's starting to show signs of instability, and I'm worried about what could happen next.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even if you incorporate it into your stories now, there's no telling how its influence might affect you, adding another layer of unpredictability.
Seemingly oblivious to your words of worry, Yugu unfurls her fan with a flick of her wrist, partially concealing her face, her voice carrying a trace of delight.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Heh, with you keeping such close watch over me, what mischief could I possibly get up to?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Or perhaps... could it be that you are actually worried about me, Chief?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Since you're under MBCC's custody, it's my duty to ensure your safety.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: As MBCC's Chief, you wouldn't simply walk away from this situation, would you?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Go ahead, tell me how you would like me to cooperate.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If I recall correctly, you mentioned that Wisps are manifestations of obsession. Once we find a way to resolve that obsession, it'll naturally fade away.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But given its current state, I think we've got our work cut out for us.

You take off your coat, turn around, and crouch down, gesturing for the little Wisp to hop in. The little one seems to recognize your coat as the same item that fell from the sky to protect it before. After a slight hesitation, it bounces right in.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: You... you'll help me, right?

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Help... help me find out... why I showed up here?
You give the little Wisp a gentle pat as your answer, then gesture toward Yugu beside you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You see this lady? She's got some amazing power. When she tells stories, she can make you "see" them come to life.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So try your best to remember, piece together the elements of what happened, and tell us about it. We'll craft it into a story and see if it reveals the "unfinished business" that's keeping you here. How does that sound?

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Thank you... Thank you both, Mister and Miss!
steps.female_content: Thank you... Thank you both, Misses!

steps.content: Yugu gracefully waves her banner before planting it in the ground, then waits with composed patience for your signal.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: My, you certainly know how to command others. Yet, as you have offered me refuge, I shall naturally comply with your desires.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Whether they be wishes or regrets, they all stem from the same desire—to find closure.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In that case, all we need to do is figure out what binds it here, and help it find its closure.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Sigh... Closure...
With a soft sigh, Yugu slowly lifts her veil. A mystical mist begins to gather around her—her unique Mania power manifesting to craft her a taleteller's sanctuary.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've got my eyes on you—no tricks up your sleeve now.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Pay me no mind, Chief. I am simply indulging in a moment of wistfulness.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Unfulfilled wishes and lingering regrets from life become the anchors that bind souls after death.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Even if we fulfill the desire of a lost soul, can its past life truly represent this present moment?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Woe is me, for when I awakened from the shadows of a cold slumber, I found myself the sole bearer of the eternal river of time—embracing all, yet profoundly solitary.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: No one bears witness, no one takes notice, no one shares in my revelry—and so I alone shall redefine the spectrum of human emotions.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Like a solitary bird, like a guttering flame, I know only to follow the path beneath my feet, ever forward... Until at last I realize my desperate awakening was all in vain, for wherever I turn lies nothing, nothing, and nothing.

The mist darkens into storm clouds that bear down upon you, trapping you in their embrace. Yugu's veil falls away completely, revealing a smile playing on her lips—but in her eyes, you see nothing but pure, unbridled frenzy.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Perhaps... obliterating this world entirely might offer a more profound satisfaction.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The story... is yet to begin.

Perhaps sensing the warning in your voice, the swirling mist suddenly halts, its violent motion gradually softening. The woman before you reins in her power and turns her attention to the little one in your arms.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Forgive me, little one. I allowed myself to be swept away... My heart merely yearns for "stories," nothing more.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Come now, tell me... what do you remember of your lingering attachments?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: What made them... become your lingering attachments?
